quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

36 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: At intersections with a "Yield" sign, you must:

options.text: Let other traffic pass if they are close enough to cause a crash.
Let traffic on your right pass only.
Always slow down and continue without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic pass if they are close enough to cause a crash.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down or stop if needed. Let any crossing or merging traffic pass if they are close enough to cause a crash.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Do not enter.
No parking.
No U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around and go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: Check your rearview mirrors:

options.text: Often to see traffic moving behind you.
To see if a car is in your blind spot.
Only when you are slowing down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Often to see traffic moving behind you.
questions.explanation: Check your rearview mirrors often while driving. This helps you know where other vehicles are around you.

questions.question: You are driving in the far right lane of a four-lane freeway and see thick broken white lines on the left side of your lane. You are driving in:

options.text: A carpool lane and must change lanes.
A special lane for slow-moving vehicles.
An exit lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: An exit lane.
questions.explanation: Large broken lines on a freeway mean that lane is ending. Be ready to exit or the lane will end.

questions.question: Which of these is a safe driving technique?

options.text: Using high beam lights in the fog.
Staring straight ahead at the road.
Checking your rearview mirrors often.

questions.correctAnswerText: Checking your rearview mirrors often.
questions.explanation: Check your rearview mirrors every two to five seconds to stay aware. Do not stare only at the road ahead. In fog, use low beam lights, not high beams.

questions.question: When you arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time as vehicles to your right and left, you should:

options.text: Let the vehicle on your left go first.
Let the vehicle on your right go first.
Wait until no vehicles are at the intersection before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the vehicle on your right go first.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no signs or signals, the vehicle on your right has the right-of-way. Then drivers proceed in the order they arrived.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about vehicles displaying a diamond-shaped hazardous material sign?

options.text: They are not allowed to drive on freeways.
They must stop before crossing railroad tracks.
They cannot go faster than 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: They must stop before crossing railroad tracks.
questions.explanation: Vehicles carrying hazardous materials must stop before crossing railroad tracks.

questions.question: In rainy weather, be extra careful when turning or stopping:

options.text: After it has been raining all day.
One half hour after the rain stops.
During the first half hour of rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: During the first half hour of rain.
questions.explanation: Be most careful during the first half hour of rain. At this time, oil from cars mixes with rain and makes the road slippery.

questions.question: What do defensive drivers think about?

options.text: Other drivers will always do the right thing.
Other drivers might make mistakes, and they are ready to react.
Other drivers will not help them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Other drivers might make mistakes, and they are ready to react.
questions.explanation: Defensive drivers expect that others may make mistakes. They are prepared to handle unexpected actions by other drivers.

questions.question: It is against the law to enter an intersection when:

options.text: You cannot get all the way across before the light turns red.
The light is flashing yellow and you did not stop first.
The light is yellow and you cannot stop safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot get all the way across before the light turns red.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection if you cannot cross it before the light turns red. Blocking an intersection can result in a ticket.

questions.question: When you approach an intersection with a flashing red traffic light, you must:

options.text: Stop completely, let traffic and pedestrians pass, then go.
Slow down and go with caution.
Stop and stay stopped as long as the light is red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, let traffic and pedestrians pass, then go.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely, let oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: A white painted curb means:

options.text: Loading zone for cargo or passengers.
Loading zone for passengers or mail only.
Loading zone for cargo only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Loading zone for passengers or mail only.
questions.explanation: At a white curb, you can stop only to pick up or drop off passengers or mail.

questions.question: When merging onto the freeway, you should drive:

options.text: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
Five to 10 mph slower than freeway traffic.
At the posted speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Merge onto the freeway at or near the speed of traffic.

questions.question: When you plan to pass another vehicle, you should:

options.text: Not assume other drivers will make room for you.
Assume the driver will let you pass if you use your turn signal.
Assume the driver will keep the same speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not assume other drivers will make room for you.
questions.explanation: Do not count on having time to pass many vehicles or assume others will make space for you. You can return to your lane when you see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: If your vehicle is about to be hit from behind, you should NOT:

options.text: Release your seat belt.
Brace yourself.
Press your head against the head restraint.

questions.correctAnswerText: Release your seat belt.
questions.explanation: When hit from behind, keep your seat belt on. Press your head against the head restraint and brace yourself against the back of your seat. Hold the steering wheel firmly and be ready to brake to avoid hitting another vehicle.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Leave the front wheels straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, turn the wheels away from the curb. When parking uphill without a curb or when parking downhill, turn the wheels toward the curb or road edge.

questions.question: If you see heavy smoke ahead on the road, you should:

options.text: Turn on your four-way flashers and keep going.
Slow down, move to the right as far as possible, and stop off the road.
Turn on your high beam lights and keep going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, move to the right as far as possible, and stop off the road.
questions.explanation: If you see heavy smoke ahead, slow down right away. Move as far right as you can and stop off the road. Then decide if it is safe to continue. Some smoke can harm your eyes, lungs, or be deadly.

questions.question: If you want to enter the freeway but do not see a gap in traffic, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed and force other drivers to make room.
Slow down on the ramp to wait for a gap.
Stop at the end of the ramp to wait for a gap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down on the ramp to wait for a gap.
questions.explanation: If you do not see a gap in traffic, slow down on the ramp and wait. Do not stop at the end of the ramp because you will not have enough room to speed up to match traffic before entering.

questions.question: A red arrow pointing right on a traffic light means you:

options.text: May turn after slowing down and checking for traffic.
Cannot turn until the light turns green.
May turn after coming to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cannot turn until the light turns green.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means stop. Wait for a green light or green arrow before turning. Do not turn against a red arrow.

questions.question: In fog, rain, or snow, you should use:

options.text: Low beams.
High beams.
Fog lights only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beams.
questions.explanation: Use low beams in fog, rain, and snow. High beams reflect back and create glare, making it hard to see.

questions.question: When a yellow light appears at the speed limit, you should:

options.text: Slow down and go through without caution.
Speed up to cross before the light turns red.
Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely.
questions.explanation: A yellow light means the light will turn red soon. Stop if you can do so safely. If you cannot stop safely, proceed with caution.

questions.question: When can minors use a cell phone without a hands-free device while driving?

options.text: When calling while stopped at a red light.
When calling for emergency help.
Never.

questions.correctAnswerText: When calling for emergency help.
questions.explanation: Minors cannot use a cell phone while driving, except to call for emergency help. Adults must use hands-free devices and should only call if needed for emergencies.

questions.question: At a yield sign, you must:

options.text: Give the right-of-way to traffic that could cause a collision.
Yield only to vehicles on your right.
Slow down but never stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic that could cause a collision.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, give the right-of-way to traffic in the lanes you want to enter or cross. Be ready to stop if there is traffic ahead, but you can keep going if the way is clear.

questions.question: This sign shows:

options.text: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The tallest vehicle allowed in this state.
The widest vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It tells you the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass (in this case, 12 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: California's "Basic Speed Law" says you must:

options.text: Drive at the same speed as other cars.
Never drive faster than is safe for the conditions.
Always drive at the posted speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never drive faster than is safe for the conditions.
questions.explanation: You must never drive faster than is safe for current conditions. For example, driving 45 mph in a 55 mph zone during heavy fog may still be too fast and result in a ticket.

questions.question: If a traffic light is broken, you should:

options.text: Stop, then go when it is safe.
Stop and let all other traffic go first.
Slow down or stop only if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: If a traffic light is off and no lights are showing, treat it like a stop sign in all directions. Stop and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: To avoid glare from oncoming headlights:

options.text: Look briefly toward the right edge of the road.
Keep looking at the road centerline.
Flash your high beams.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look briefly toward the right edge of the road.
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road to avoid bright headlights. Then look ahead to check the other vehicle's position.

questions.question: If about to be hit from behind, do NOT:

options.text: Apply your brakes.
Let go of the steering wheel.
Press your head against the headrest.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let go of the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If hit from behind, keep a firm grip on the steering wheel. Press yourself against your seat and put your head against the headrest to prevent whiplash. Be ready to brake if needed.

questions.question: When traffic is merging into your freeway lane, you should:

options.text: Make room for the merging traffic if possible.
Speed up to protect your right-of-way.
Always keep your current position.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make room for the merging traffic if possible.
questions.explanation: When it is safe, make room to let vehicles merge into your lane.

questions.question: If your car begins to skid, you should:

options.text: Brake lightly.
Stay off the brakes.
Brake hard.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay off the brakes.
questions.explanation: Do not use the brakes during a skid. Braking can make it worse.

questions.question: If your car skids out of control, you should:

options.text: Pump the brakes.
Apply light brake pressure.
Stay off the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay off the brakes.
questions.explanation: Stay off the brakes during a skid. Keep steering until the vehicle is under control and moving safely.

questions.question: This white sign means:

options.text: Slow down and move to the right lane.
If you are driving slowly, stay in the right lane.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you are driving slowly, stay in the right lane.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to keep the left lane open for faster traffic. If you are driving slower than other cars, use the right lane.

questions.question: A vehicle cuts in front of you suddenly. What should you do first?

options.text: Honk and brake hard.
Take your foot off the gas.
Swerve into the next lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take your foot off the gas.
questions.explanation: If a car cuts in front of you, take your foot off the gas pedal. This creates space without requiring hard braking or swerving.

questions.question: A steady red arrow on a traffic light means:

options.text: You cannot turn in that direction.
You can turn after coming to a complete stop.
You can turn in that direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn in that direction.
questions.explanation: A steady red arrow means you cannot go in that direction. Stop and wait for a green signal.

questions.question: If your car's rear end skids left, you should:

options.text: Steer right.
Steer left.
Tap the brakes and shift to neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer left.
questions.explanation: When skidding, steer in the direction you want to go. If the rear skids left, steer left to straighten the car.

questions.question: It is illegal to leave a child age ____ or younger alone in a vehicle.

options.text: Eight
Seven
Six

questions.correctAnswerText: Six
questions.explanation: It is illegal to leave a child age six or younger alone in a car. A child can be left unattended only if supervised by someone age 12 or older.
